hook.name: flETHHooks
hook.description: A constant-sum 1:1 custom-curve hook for ETH/flETH pools. In beforeSwap, it takes the full input amount, converts it via flETH deposit or withdraw (1:1), and settles the output back to the PoolManager — completely bypassing concentrated liquidity. Direct liquidity addition is blocked; only the ETH/flETH pair with zero fee is accepted.
